To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Azathioprine and methotrexate induced dose-dependent morphological and functional alterations in the kidney of adult wistar rats.
Azathioprine 50 mg/kg/day and 150 mg/kg/day as well as Methotrexate 8 mg/kg/week and 20 mg/kg/week impaired the morphology and the functions of the kidney of adult male wistar rats.
Azathioprine and Methotrexate impaired morphology and functions of kidney of adult wistar rats.

the nephrotoxicty of Azathiopine and Methotrexat, which are commonly used in the treatment of cancer.
